title: Reconstructing a state from two coordinates
statement: Let $\mathrm{st}$ be a state record with fifteen natural-number coordinates, and let $v$ be another fifteen-entry vector of natural numbers. Suppose that $v$ agrees with the coordinate vector of $\mathrm{st}$ at every coordinate other than the width-cap coordinate and the pointer-of-width-check coordinate. Then $v$ is the coordinate vector of the state obtained from $\mathrm{st}$ by replacing those two coordinates with the corresponding entries of $v$.
